name: filetree
description: The project's file tree in a pane beside the chat, lit up as Claude reads, edits and commits files. Read-only.

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the pane at session start where the screen can dock it beside the chat (fullscreen terminal, desktop app) and there is room. Never reopens it after you close it; /filetree still toggles it.

maxDepth.title: Maximum depth
maxDepth.description: How many directory levels the tree scans below the working directory.

maxEntries.title: Maximum entries
maxEntries.description: The most files and folders the tree holds; the rest show as +N more.

extraIgnore.title: Extra ignored names
extraIgnore.description: Comma-separated folder or file names to hide, besides .git, node_modules, target, renv, .Rproj.user, __pycache__, .venv, dist and build.
